findings.evidence: MCP runtime has no incarnation; frozen handlers dereference current manager session, so Run A can execute session B. Connect marks running before per-tool registration completes, allowing partial fresh catalog; revision source fingerprints state only.
findings.root_cause: MCP lifecycle, catalog identity and dispatch authority are split without atomic incarnation-bearing server snapshot.

conclusion.summary: Create manager-owned opaque incarnation after initialize/list_tools; atomically publish full server set before running; include incarnation/schema/remote/build identity in frozen source and require execution-time match. Spike identical/changed schema reconnect, failure and registration barrier; old Run must stale, new Run uses new complete generation.
